Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-prompt-medium-0039-reverse-09", "row_sha256": "7888e8741b80d30b4e094505f39c29a5e9e28561f696f1434569772659a870ea", "mode": "/prompt", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Organize the supplied request into a clear prompt. Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "can you write a short email invitation for our seed exchange at the Eastside Community Garden on saturday, april 18, from 10 a.m. to noon. it's the spring swap, and people can bring vegetable, herb, or flower seeds in labeled envelopes; they don't need to bring seeds to take some home. we'll have a check-in table by the greenhouse and a small area for people to compare planting notes. mention that seeds should be dry and clearly labeled with the plant name and, if known, the year collected. the garden has no parking lot, so say that visitors can use the bike racks or street parking on Alder Lane. there will be no formal program; people can browse at their own pace, and leftover packets will stay on the table until noon. keep the message friendly and straightforward, and don't make it sound like people need to register. please address the invitation to Jasper, not Celeste, and make that recipient choice explicit in the greeting. add a subject line, include the date and hours, and end with a simple sign-off from the garden volunteers. don't add a phone number or claim that refreshments will be provided. we only need the email text, not a flyer or social post.", "output": "Write a short, friendly, straightforward email invitation for the spring seed swap at the Eastside Community Garden on Saturday, April 18, from 10 a.m. to noon. Address it to Jasper, not Celeste, and make that recipient choice explicit in the greeting. Include a subject line and end with a simple sign-off from the garden volunteers.

Mention that visitors may bring vegetable, herb, or flower seeds in labeled envelopes, but they do not need to bring seeds to take some home. Seeds should be dry and clearly labeled with the plant name and, if known, the year collected. Include the check-in table by the greenhouse and the small area for comparing planting notes. Explain that there is no parking lot, and visitors can use the bike racks or street parking on Alder Lane. Note that there will be no formal program, people can browse at their own pace, and leftover packets will stay on the table until noon.

Do not make registration sound necessary. Do not add a phone number or say that refreshments will be provided. Provide only the email text, not a flyer or social post."}]
